title: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
description: Alice follows a hurried White Rabbit underground and tumbles into a world of impossible size changes, talking animals, curious riddles and a Queen who wants everything her own way.
catalogueBlurb: Follow Alice down the rabbit-hole into a world where almost nothing makes sense.
author: Lewis Carroll, retold by Quill
